description: This file defines the Sale controller class for the Opencart admin dashboard, handling display and saving of sale-related dashboard data, including sales statistics and configuration.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: Controller class for managing the sale dashboard in Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the sale dashboard page with sales data and configuration options.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of dashboard configuration settings via POST request.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns sales statistics and percentage change for display on the dashboard.
